User: Preston has a sandwich shop. He charges $5 for each sandwich. He also charges $20 for a delivery fee. Abra Company orders 18 sandwiches from Preston and also tips him 10%. How much total, in dollars, did Preston receive?
Assistant: <think>

First, I need to calculate the total cost of the sandwiches, including the delivery fee. So, 18 sandwiches at $5 each is 18 * 5 = $90. Adding the delivery fee of $20, the total before the tip is 90 + 20 = $110. Now, Abra Company is tipping 10% of the total, which is 10% of 110, so 0.10 * 110 = $11. This is the tip amount. Adding the tip to the total cost of the sandwiches and delivery fee, 110 + 11 = $121. So, Preston received a total of $121. </think> <answer> 121 </answer>
